question:
Match the column:

 
 

 
 
**Column A**

 
**(Status Category)**

 
 
 
**Column B **

 
**(Public Sector Enterprise)**

 
 
 

 
 
A.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Maharatna:** Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) is designated as a Maharatna Public Sector Enterprise due to its significant financial and operational autonomy.
 
• **Navratna:** Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited (MTNL) holds Navratna status for its moderate level of autonomy compared to Maharatna companies.
 
• **Miniratna:** Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC) is categorized as a Miniratna Public Sector Enterprise due to its smaller scale and limited operational independence.
 
• Maharatna, Navratna, and Miniratna classifications were introduced to provide autonomy to Public Sector Enterprises based on their financial performance and operational efficiency.
 
• Option 3 correctly matches these enterprises with their respective status categories: A - 3 (SAIL), B - 1 (MTNL), C - 2 (IRCTC).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharatna Status:** Companies with Maharatna status are granted greater financial and operational autonomy, enabling them to make large-scale investments of up to Rs. 5,000 crore without government approval.
 
• **Navratna Status:** Navratna companies have moderate autonomy, allowing them to invest up to Rs. 1,000 crore without government intervention.
 
• **Miniratna Status:** Miniratna enterprises are divided into two categories (Category I and II) based on profitability and have limited autonomy in comparison to Maharatna and Navratna companies.
 
• **Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs):** These are organizations wholly or partially owned by the Government of India, established to achieve socio-economic objectives and promote industrial growth.
 
• **Classification Criteria:** The classification into Maharatna, Navratna, and Miniratna depends on factors such as net worth, profitability, and revenue, as defined by the Department of Public Enterprises (DPE).
